gloss: to joke; to crack a joke

definitions.gloss: to joke; to crack a joke; to say something humorous
definitions.explanation: To make a humorous remark or tell a joke. Can also be used sarcastically when someone says something absurd or unbelievable.

examples.japanese: {冗談|じょうだん}を{言|い}って{場|ば}を{和|なご}ませた。
examples.english: I cracked a joke to lighten the mood.

examples.japanese: {冗談|じょうだん}を{言|い}っているのか{本気|ほんき}なのか{分|わ}からない。
examples.english: I can't tell if he's joking or being serious.

examples.japanese: {冗談|じょうだん}を{言|い}うのはやめてくれ。{今|いま}は{真剣|しんけん}な{話|はなし}をしているんだ。
examples.english: Stop joking around. We're having a serious discussion right now.

notes:
The standard expression for "to tell a joke" or "to joke around." {冗談|じょうだん} means "joke" and {言|い}う means "to say." The combination is extremely common in daily conversation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {冗談|じょうだん}を{言|い}う — to joke, to crack a joke
- {冗談|じょうだん}じゃない — that's no joke; I'm serious (used to deny joking)
- {冗談|じょうだん}でしょう？ — you're joking, right? (disbelief)
- {冗談|じょうだん}はよせ — cut it out with the jokes
- {冗談|じょうだん}が{通|つう}じない{人|ひと} — a person who can't take a joke

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ふざける — to joke around, to fool around (less about telling jokes, more about playful behavior)
- からかう — to tease, to make fun of (directed at a specific person)
- おどける — to clown around, to act funny (physical humor)

USAGE:
{冗談|じょうだん}を{言|い}っている{場合|ばあい}じゃない ("this is no time for jokes") is a set phrase used to express urgency or seriousness. {冗談|じょうだん}でしょう is commonly used to express disbelief, similar to English "You must be kidding."
